summary: The City of Glendive's parks page describes Jaycee West Park (west edge of the Yellowstone River, built in the 1970s, playground, tennis courts, horseshoe area) but says nothing about camping, RVs, fees or stay limits. Nothing confirmed or changed; the derived free / FCFS / 3-night / 80-ft / no-hookup / flush-toilet / water values are not on any official page.
flags: Criteria: camping may not be allowed at all. The city's parks page (the entry's website) never mentions camping, although the inclusion evidence cites it for 'free drive-in self-contained RV camping, 80-ft max'. In search results Campendium's listing for Jaycee West Park, Glendive is marked 'Permanently Closed' (last report 2021) with a reviewer noting a sign reading no camping for RVs or tents, and AllStays calls it discreet overnight dry parking tolerated 'but not if you ask or blatantly camp'. A human should decide whether this entry stays; a call to the city would settle it.
